subject: Island 014 Royal Palace layered royal honey cathedral front facade

reviewPolicy.evidenceScope: actual-mesh materials-off geometry and attachment; final color hierarchy remains for the later live-runtime beauty gate

perViewScores.note: The large pointed double-door and thick arch are unmistakably first, the rose is second, and four bays are individually visible. The rose is oversized and panel-like, the bay housings read as detached little pediments, and the floor bands/ribs do not yet bind the elements into the source's inhabited vertical cathedral axis.

Real layer thickness is proven, with no obvious z-fight. The rose/frame assembly projects too far as a separate panel and the right-side bays sit proud as discrete housings rather than embedded honeycomb architecture.
The mirrored oblique view confirms the same forward-mounted rose, detached bay-house read, and weak connection from lower door to upper facade.

The multi-layer arch, pointed door, seam, handles, and bee sigil have strong readable geometry. The close crop also shows that the oversized arch/door consumes most of the lower facade while the connecting bands intersect the door zone instead of cleanly stepping around it.

doorFirstFocalPoint.finding: The broad pointed door and layered arch dominate the facade and exceed the stair-arrival width.

roseSecondFocalPoint.finding: The six-cell rose is clearly second, but its oversized forward panel competes too aggressively and appears insufficiently embedded.

fourLargeBays.finding: Two lower and two upper bays are present and legible, but their deep pediment housings read as attachments rather than occupied facade bays.

connectingBandsAndRibs.finding: Existing horizontal bands and diagonal ribs do not create a continuous entrance-to-rose axis; the lower band visually cuts through the door zone in materials-off evidence.

bannerClearance.finding: The two existing banner cloths sit just outside the door width and above the opening, but the clearance is small and must not regress.

floatOrZFight.finding: No z-fighting is visible, but oblique views make the rose and bay frames read as overly proud panels rather than deeply attached architecture.

largestMismatch: The exact source facade is a tightly integrated vertical cathedral: a strong royal doorway rises through occupied honeycomb bays into a rose window embedded in the keep. This blockout has the correct feature inventory and focal order, but the rose and four bays read as separate forward-mounted housings and the bands/ribs fail to unify them into one architectural axis.

boundedCorrection.falsifiableHypothesis: If the existing rose and four bay assemblies are reduced slightly and embedded closer to their frozen hosts, while the existing floor bands and axis ribs are shortened/repositioned to frame rather than cross the door and to connect the bay levels into the rose, the same feature set will read as one source-like inhabited cathedral facade while preserving the door-first and rose-second phone hierarchy.
allowedVariablesAndFeatures: scale, X/Y/Z position, tilt, backing depth, and frame thickness of the existing ISLAND_14_PALACE_FACADE_ROSE_WINDOW assembly only
scale, X/Y/Z position, dark-inset depth, and frame thickness of the four existing ISLAND_14_PALACE_FACADE_*_BAY_* assemblies only
length, thickness, X/Y/Z position, and tilt of the existing ISLAND_14_PALACE_FACADE_FLOOR_BAND_* and ISLAND_14_PALACE_FACADE_AXIS_RIB_* meshes only
recess depth and arch-layer thickness of the existing door recess, royal double door, outer arch, and inner arch without reducing door width
X/Y/Z position of the two existing facade banner groups only, solely to preserve clear side placement
frozenDuringCorrection: facade feature count and feature types
door width, stair axis, bee sigil, handles, and door seam
accepted palace macro dimensions, transforms, court, stairs, keep, domes, and bay bodies
materials, honey, mission, robots, terrain, camera, and gameplay
boundedCorrection.hardRejectThreshold: Retire the family if the corrected worst required score is below 0.85, if worst-score gain is below +0.10, if the door is not the first focal point, if the rose is not second or remains visibly forward-floating, if fewer than four bays remain individually legible, if any band crosses the door opening, if either banner enters the door or stair-clearance zone, or if any float/z-fight appears.
